points.quote: Create an identifier with the same name: `export const IFooService = createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService');`. `createDecorator` is in `instantiation.ts:109`.
**Constructor injection:** use the identifier as a parameter decorator, after any non-service arguments. `constructor(arg: string, @IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService) {}`
**Creating objects:** `IInstantiationService.createInstance(Ctor, ...staticArgs)` looks up each dependency and appends it to the arguments.

Registrations are collected in a registry. They are turned into descriptors when the `InstantiationService` is created. Workbench services are usually registered in `workbench.common.main.ts` and similar entry files.
